d:
Leopold Aschenbrenner was hailed as a man who could see the future clearer than anyone else. He managed to build a $45 billion empire on AI investments alone, but when the market turned he suffered a catastrophic loss. While he quickly got back on his feet and began trading again, do these events give us any insights into the AI frenzy in the current financial markets?
